protocol.features: every feature the GUI offers (6 families, scales 0.3 (smoothing only) to 10), computed in 2D on every channel
protocol.classifier: ParallelVigraRfLazyflowClassifierFactory(100), the default of a new project; LAZYFLOW_THREADS=8 set by env.sh (lazyflow's own default is the CPU count), so 8 sub-forests as on an 8-core desktop; checked per seed in ilastik_runs

note: the official ilastik 1.4.2 Pixel Classification, trained headless on the support labels
